overview.purpose_zh: 这张图把收入、成本、利润三个指标并排放在一起，横条是实际值，竖线是目标，用来看哪一项达标、哪一项没达标。
works_zh: 适合三个左右指标并排对照目标
适合空间有限的周报和仪表盘
适合一眼区分达标项和未达标项
uses_zh: 财务和运营联席会的开场页

understanding.read_zh: 先看每根横条的长度，它代表实际值；再看穿过横条的竖线，那是目标。横条末端在竖线右边，实际值高于目标；在左边，实际值低于目标。还要记住：不是所有指标都是越高越好，成本高于目标反而是坏消息，利润低于目标才是没达标。

elements.note_zh: 横条长度表示实际值，这一页里三个指标都用千美元。
每行中间细的竖线，标出该项指标的目标值。
左边写明指标名称：收入、成本、利润。
三个指标同用千美元，可以直接并排看，但方向好坏不同。

look_for_zh: 每根横条末端与竖向目标线的相对位置
收入和成本都高于目标，但只有收入是好事
利润低于目标，说明这一项没达标

observations.en: Revenue reached 194 against a target of 190, so it came in 4 above target.
observations.zh: 收入达到 194，目标是 190，比目标高 4。

observations.en: Costs were 128 against a target of 120, 8 over target.
observations.zh: 成本为 128，目标是 120，超出目标 8。

observations.en: Profit was 66 against a target of 70, 4 below target and about 94 percent of the goal.
observations.zh: 利润为 66，目标是 70，比目标低 4，约为目标的 94%。

observations.en: Revenue and costs both sit above their targets, but only revenue is a good result; higher costs work against profit.
observations.zh: 收入和成本都高于目标，但只有收入是好结果；成本更高会压低利润。

describe.en: The bullet chart compares three metrics with their targets: revenue, costs and profit.
describe.zh: 这张子弹图把收入、成本、利润三个指标与各自的目标作比较。
describe.pattern: The chart compares A, B and C with their targets
alternatives: The chart puts three profit-and-loss metrics side by side against their targets.
The bullet chart shows how revenue, costs and profit each measure up to target.
describe.note_zh: 开头点明是三个指标对照目标，而不是三个指标互相比大小。

describe.en: Revenue beat its 190 target at 194, while profit missed its 70 target at 66.
describe.zh: 收入以 194 超过 190 的目标，利润则以 66 没达到 70 的目标。
alternatives: Revenue finished at 194 against a 190 target, but profit finished at 66 against 70.
Revenue beat its 190 target, but profit fell short of its 70 target at 66.
describe.note_zh: 同一句里一个 beat 一个 miss，达标和没达标立刻分开。

describe.en: Costs were higher than their 120 target, at 128, which is not a good sign.
describe.zh: 成本为 128，高于 120 的目标，这不是好信号。
describe.pattern: A + be + higher than + target + at + figure
alternatives: Costs came in at 128, above the 120 target.
At 128, costs overshot their 120 target by 8.
describe.note_zh: higher than 只说高低，不说好坏；后半句要自己补上判断。

describe.en: Profit was lower than its 70 target, finishing at 66.
describe.zh: 利润低于 70 的目标，最终只有 66。
describe.pattern: A + be + lower than + target + finishing at + figure
alternatives: Profit ended at 66, below the 70 target.
At 66, profit came in under its 70 target.
describe.note_zh: 比较结构有两种：higher/lower than + 名词，或者 above/below + 数字；不要写成 lower than 66 这种把目标和实际绕在一起的说法。

describe.en: The variance between the 190 revenue target and the actual 194 was 4.
describe.zh: 190 的收入目标和 194 的实际数字之间相差 4。
describe.pattern: the variance between A and B was + amount
alternatives: Revenue showed a variance of 4 against its 190 target.
The revenue variance was 4, with 194 achieved against a 190 plan.
describe.note_zh: variance 是财务和运营复盘里的常用词，专门指实际与目标或预算的差。

describe.en: As you can see from this chart, revenue is just above target, but profit is below.
describe.zh: 从这张图可以看到，收入略高于目标，但利润低于目标。
describe.pattern: As you can see from this chart, + clause
alternatives: As the chart shows, the revenue bar clears its target while the profit bar does not.
As you can see here, only one of the three bars is short of its target.
describe.note_zh: 开场或翻页时用，前提是听众正看着同一张图。

describe.en: Overall, two of the three metrics beat their targets, but the profit miss is the one that matters.
describe.zh: 总体来看，三个指标里有两个超过目标，但真正要紧的是利润没达标。
alternatives: Overall, the chart looks positive on revenue but weak on profit.
Overall, the profit shortfall is the finding to act on.
describe.note_zh: 整体概括要挑出真正需要行动的那一项，不能因为两项达标就报喜不报忧。

academic.en: The bullet chart compares three profit-and-loss metrics with their targets, all in thousands of dollars. Revenue reached 194 against a target of 190, and costs reached 128 against a target of 120. Profit, however, finished at 66 against a target of 70. Revenue and costs therefore exceed their targets by 4 and 8 respectively, while profit falls 4 short. The direction of each excess differs: higher revenue is favorable, whereas higher costs are not.
academic.zh: 这张子弹图把三个收支指标与各自的目标作比较，单位都是千美元。收入为 194，目标是 190；成本为 128，目标是 120。利润则相反，为 66，目标是 70。因此收入和成本分别超出目标 4 和 8，利润则差 4。多出来的方向并不相同：收入更高是好事，成本更高则不是。

business.en: Revenue beat plan at 194 versus a 190 target, but costs also came in above plan at 128 against 120, and that combination left profit at 66, 4 short of its 70 target. The key message is that top-line growth is not translating into bottom-line delivery. The team should treat the cost overrun, not the revenue result, as the item to fix before the next review.
business.zh: 收入以 194 超过 190 的目标，但成本也高于计划，为 128，目标是 120，两者相抵后利润只有 66，比 70 的目标低 4。关键信息是：收入增长没有转化为利润。团队在下次复盘前要处理的是成本超支，而不是收入成绩。

simple.en: This chart shows three numbers and their targets. Revenue is 194, above the 190 target. Costs are 128, above the 120 target, but for costs that is bad news. Profit is 66, below the 70 target. So revenue looks good, costs are too high, and profit is short by 4.
simple.zh: 这张图显示三个数字和它们的目标。收入是 194，高于 190 的目标。成本是 128，高于 120 的目标，但对成本来说这是坏消息。利润是 66，低于 70 的目标。所以收入看起来不错，成本太高，利润还差 4。

language_notes.title_en: Above target is not always good
language_notes.body_zh: above target 只说明实际值比目标大，不说明结果好。收入 above target 是好事，成本 above target 是坏事；要表达好坏，得自己补一句 favorable 或 a problem，不能只靠 above。
beat the target 是超过目标，miss the target 是没达到，两者都直接接宾语，不加 by 或 to。要给出差距时再用 by：missed the target by 4。
